notes.title: Update 1.4.2 LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
We've just released an update that fixes a number of bugs in Creative Mode and adds some bits of polish. Enjoy!

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Creative levels now need to have a description before you can upload them.
[*] Cities in creative mode can now only rotate 90 degrees to prevent problems with houses that spawn around the cities.
[*] Added that you can now brush decorations with an even lower density.
[*] Added three possible random cards to new creative levels by default: cheap rails, cheap bridges and heavy freight train.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed that diorama mode would persist in campaign levels after playing a creative level with diorama mode active.
[*] Fixed that the game might boot up a VR device or that it might crash if you have a VR device installed. (Please let us know if the issue persists!)
[*] Fixed that you could open a broken state of a level when you open a save of a creative level that has been deleted.
[*] Fixed various models not turning red on invalid locations in creative mode
[*] Fixed that clicking the “open level page in browser” would sometimes give the browser a wrong URL.
[*] Fixed that the “sort by” dropdown in the mod browser would add additional dropdown entries on reopening the mod browser.
[*] Fixed that the density setting didn’t do enough for “dense forest” and “impenetrable rocks”. 
[*] Fixed that “no building connection” pins on stations would reappear when you removed them, by disabling and enabling the HUD or taking a Steam screenshot.
[*] Fixed that the controller becomes unresponsive during the credits.
[*] Fixed that the credits wouldn’t scroll all the way up before it disappears.
[*] Fixed that changing the graphics options using a controller wouldn’t save the new options.
[*] Fixed that animals would sometimes be invisible while placing them in creative mode.
[*] Fixed various texts and naming improvements.
[*] Fixed various localization issues in which the text wouldn’t fit in their box.
[/list]

notes.title: An Early Look at our December Update
notes.notes:
Hello conductors, 

One of the most requested features for Station to Station has always been a photo mode, followed very closely by a ride-along cam. 

We’re pleased to share that our free December update will include both of these features, along with more content that will be detailed below! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/d6b348218797fcbe93c612ac75a092aef886ec60.png[/img]

The brand-new photo mode will offer a few different options to help you craft the perfect photo opportunity in game. 

We’ve also added 4 new optional tiny levels sprinkled across 4 different regions in the game and custom mode has received a huge update to make it even more customisable. 

[h3]This new update will launch in less than a week on Tuesday 12th of December! [/h3]

This will be our last update of 2023, but there will be more content coming in 2024! We have a lot planned as a way to say thank you for all your support. 

We hope to see you there! 

- Galaxy Grove

notes.title: Prepare for Prospecting in the Upcoming Station to Station Update!
notes.notes:
Hello conductors, 

Thank you for an incredible first month of Station to Station! We’ve been overwhelmed by the positive support from you all so far and we can’t wait to share more content with you in the future. 

So, this is the perfect time to introduce our next region - [b]Nugget Creek[/b]!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/d401bac1bc63ef19d7b47b5a3d759b14a0607b3c.png[/img]

Our new update will take you to the Gold Rush era for 5 new levels, and 4 new industries, as well as a new animal and a new environmental obstacle. 

We’ve also squeezed in an update to the custom game mode and you’ll be able to try all of these new features out when the new update releases in just one week! 

[h3]This new update will launch on the 14th of November 2023[/h3]

In case you haven’t seen it yet, here’s our current roadmap for Station to Station. Nugget Creek is our November update and there’ll be another update coming next month as well! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115269/a91784cc7e4deab1c16f60484c1f5bda02a115fd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.2 (3457)
notes.notes:
Hello conductors! 

Thank you for continuing to report bugs all the bugs that you've found in Station to Station! We will continue to squash them as fast as we can for you. 

Here's a full list of fixes for this patch: 
[list]
[*] Added some more variation to trees in Riverbend Woods.
[*] Fixed that completing the fund challenge would in rare circumstances sometimes not save.
[*] Made an automatic backup system for saves, hopefully fixing the issue that in extremely rare cases all progress would be lost. [b]Please contact us if this issue still happens to you![/b]
[*] Fixed that parallel tracks would sometimes not be recognized.
[*] Fixed that while creating a railroad, hovering over lost goods or building spawn indicators would block the railroad.
[*] Fixed that you could have multiple keys assigned to the same key binding after pressing "reset to defaults".
[*] Fixed that the game would not respond to gamepad input when you press select on the level completed popup while using gamepad.
[*] Fixed that the bridge warning would sometimes not appear in level Greendale 4.
[*] Fixed that entering station mode while choosing an industry to build would spawn the new industry in the corner of the map.
[*] Optimized performance while creating a new railroad. Long railroads now reduce the framerate much less.
[*] Minor tweaks and fixes to railroad visuals.
[*] Fixed missing lines in the localization.
[*] Fixed that enabling and disabling cards using gamepad forced the train selection wheel to re-open after it has been closed, causing some issues.
[*] Fixed that a dragged station would automatically be placed when you clicked on the pause button.
[*] Fixed that certain tooltips would persist on the screen during Create Industry and Upgrade City mode while using gamepad.
[*] Fixed that you could break the tutorial by entering station mode in the first second of the first tutorial.
[*] Fixed that the gamepad cursor would sometimes be visible when it should be hidden.
[*] User interface tweaks to remove overlapping UI and out of bound texts in certain cases.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.1 (3365)
notes.notes:
Hello conductors! 

Thank you for your patience as we worked on this patch to fix our launch day bugs. Here's a full list of fixes for this patch: 
[list]
[*] Fixed that in certain circumstances level 2 would not unlock after finishing level 1. We hope that this is now fixed as we could not reproduce this ourselves, but we implemented a fix that should work with the reports we received.
[*] Fixed that deleting a manual save would duplicate the manual saves in the load screen interface.
[*] Fixed that loading a game from the pause menu in level 1 would ask you to save level this level (but this level can not be saved due to the tutorial complexity).
[*] Fixed that the gamepad would get stuck when you back out of the "Press A to go to the next level" message in the bottom right corner after completing a level and pressing Select.
[*] Fixed that a blueprint station could lose its connections to buildings when you enter station mode while dragging a station.
[*] Fixed that the gamepad left stick could get stuck sometimes while dragging an anchor point.
[*] Added a few missing translations for Chinese Simplified and Chinese Traditional.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
These are the patch notes for Version 0.1.1 of the Station to Station demo: 

[h2]Small changes:[/h2]
- Removed the "Show advanced settings" option and set the advanced settings to visible by default.

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
- Fixed missing translation lines for Malay.
- Fixed a formatting error in the Russian translation.
- Fixed that a new building would not automatically connect to a nearby station if it fell down in a station's range.
- Fixed that sometimes the cheaper bridges card tutorial would appear even if you don't have the card in your hand.
- Fixed a visual bug with station connectors that keep showing as unavailable even if they are available.
- Fixed that the level completion pop-up and the result screen window were overlapping in some instances.
- Fixed a bug in which the hover-over tooltip for unlock buttons would still show on hidden buttons.
- Improved the performance while building a railroad.

Thank you for diligently reporting all of these bugs and sharing feedback on the demo! We are reading every message, discussion post, and survey entry, so please keep them coming. 

If you haven't already, please fill out our [url=https://forms.gle/p4GkWbyLp26SAgmf9]feedback form[/url] to help us make the full game even better.

notes.title: Demo Version 0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Version 0.1 of the Station to Station demo has been uploaded. These patch notes summarise the updates for the latest patch. 

[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Support was added for the following languages:
- Arabic
- German
- Spanish (Latin America)
- Spanish (Spain)
- French
- Hindi
- Italian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Malay
- Polish
- Portuguese - Brazil
- Russian
- Thai
- Turkish
- Vietnamese
- Simplified Chinese
[*]The church now upgrades to a third, even bigger version when a town is completed.
[*]When starting a level, the intro screen now has background music.
[*]Most carriage couplings now stay attached better when the train goes over the top of a small and high bridge.
[/list]

[h2]Small changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Tweaked auto-detection of graphics settings to favor framerate over graphics quality more.
[*]Improved framerate when creating new railroads in a level that already has a lot of stations.
[*]Improved framerate in situations where the camera is fully zoomed in and the sun is behind the camera.
[*]Improved framerate in main menu by disabling invisible background rendering.
[*]Removed the word “Loading” from the loading screen
[*]Houses in cities now spawn when the church lands instead of before
[*]Advanced graphic settings are now hidden behind a new checkbox
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the button for level two, where it would glow despite it being completed.
[*]Fixed a bug where pressing spacebar in the pause menu or settings makes it open again after closing. 
[*]Fixed a bug where the tooltip did not show up when the player did not have enough money. 
[*]Fixed the fund challenge thumbnail so that it accurately represents what percentage complete it is.
[*]Fixed that a part of the anchor point tutorial would mistakenly appear in level 2 or when you are not in tutorial mode. 
[*]Fixed that the railroad price would not display as green when using a cheaper rails card.  
[*]Fixed that station connectors and railroad anchor points looked blurry when the camera was zoomed in.
[*]One of the cliffs in level 1 has been changed so you can no longer softlock yourself by placing a station in between the cliff and the building by blocking off all station connectors. 
[*]You can now no longer lose a fund goal that was already achieved after level completion. 
[*]New cards and new building icons are no longer placed over the settings menu.
[*]It’s no longer possible to have two level completion windows overlap each other. 
[*]It’s no longer possible to softlock yourself in level 1 when building a railway with bridges during the tutorial.
[*]Fixed that sometimes the unlock building tutorial message was stuck on the screen
[*]Fixed that there were holes in some of the rock models
[*]Buildings now look for a new, nearby spawn position when there is already a railroad or station on the intended position of a building. (Previously they would just drop on top of the railroad or station.)
[*]Fixed that the game was called UE4 in taskbar and processes.
[*]Fixed that some tunes would not continue playing when setting music volume to 0 and then back to an audible volume.
[*]Fixed that graphics auto-detect didn’t affect the settings for fields and props.
[*]Fixed Visual Effects quality setting affecting a number of props in level
[*]The pause menu will no longer close when pressing the following buttons: Left Alt, Right Alt, Left Cmd, Right Cmd, Tab, Left Ctrl
[*]Fixed multiple keys not working when being rebound in the control section
[*]Removed “Reset to defaults” option from graphics settings, because defaults differ based on hardware and that’s what the auto-detect button already does.
[*]Fixed that you could place a station on top of a building if you press space and click at the same time while hovering over a building.
[*]Tooltip for unlocks no longer shows when there are no more unlocks available in the level
[/list]

A number of these new features are based on your feedback, so keep it coming! Many of these bugs were also solved by your reporting, so thank you for being so diligent. 

We hope you enjoy these new changes and please fill out [url=https://forms.gle/p4GkWbyLp26SAgmf9]our feedback form[/url], if you haven't already. We're reading every response to make sure we can make the full game even better!

Galaxy Grove
